reason: The DefaultIndexProfileHandler validation reorder and the change from replacing to merging index.Properties affects all indexing providers (not just Azure AI Search), and the broad AzureAISearchIndexProfileHandler refactor changes validation/initialization scope from content-only to all Azure AI index profiles, creating real regression risk for existing index configurations across tenants.
